claims: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket is scheduled to launch 29 Starlink satellites on Sunday, March 29, 2026, from Cape Canaveral, FL.
SpaceX Falcon 9 launch window opens at 5:15 p.m. ET.
SpaceX Starlink 10-44 mission uses Falcon 9 rocket.
SpaceX Starlink 10-44 mission is scheduled for Sunday, March 29, 2026, 5:15 p.m. – 9:15 p.m. ET.
SpaceX Starlink 10-44 mission launch site is Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Launch Complex 40.
Florida Today stated that the SpaceX launch may be visible along the northeast trajectory.
A ULA Atlas V rocket is scheduled to launch on Sunday, March 29, 2026 at 3:53 a.m. ET from Cape Canaveral, FL.
ULA Atlas V launch is Amazon Leo.
Rocket Lab Electron is scheduled to launch March 29/30 (NZDT) from New Zealand.
